function.name: calculate_slope_gradient
function.description: Calculate the slope gradient between two geographical coordinates. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

point1.description: The geographic coordinates for the first point [Latitude, Longitude].

point2.description: The geographic coordinates for the second point [Latitude, Longitude].

unit.description: The unit for the slope gradient. Default is 'degree'.

message.content:
要計算兩個地理坐標之間的坡度（斜率），我們需要知道這兩個點的海拔高度差。  
目前您只提供了緯度與經度，若沒有相對應的高程資料，我們無法直接得到坡度值。

請問您是否有以下資訊可供使用？

| 點 | 緯度 | 經度 | 海拔（米） |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 40.7128 | -74.0060 | ? |
| 2 | 34.0522 | -118.2437 | ? |

如果您能提供每個點的海拔（或至少兩者之間的海拔差），我就可以幫您計算出坡度（以度、百分比或比例表示）。

So we cannot compute slope without elevation. We can ask for elevation or approximate using known elevations: NYC ~10 m above sea level, LA ~71 m? Actually LA's average elevation ~71 m. But we might not know. We could ask user for elevation values. Or we can explain that we need elevation differences. The user didn't provide elevation.
